instruction: Within the VScode workspace found at ~/Library/example_code3, substitute every tab character (\t) across all files with exactly four spaces. Leave all other content untouched. Ignore any potential syntax errors or formatting issues in the files.

command:
printf '#!/bin/bash
for f in *.txt; do
	echo "Processing $f"
	cat "$f" | while read line; do
		echo "	$line"
	done
done
' > ~/Library/example_code3/run.sh
